supplement:gomez_zepeda_2024_jy.csv.upstream_description: Nature Comms S5+S6 (deep profiling) + S3+S4 (method comparison)

ms_source_provenance.query_scope: All 8–15mers across full sequences of every positive eligible proteoform, before specificity subtraction

source_provenance.background_cta_identity: curated IDs plus exact-symbol HSCHR alternate-haplotype annotations of the same gene
source_provenance.ms_modality_policy: positive MS assay method, curated MS-only supplement, or declared supplied modality; explicit non-MS rejected
source_provenance.tissue_map_scope: All 8–15mers across full sequences of every positive eligible proteoform, before specificity subtraction

verified_normal_ms.coverage: Supplied Atlas snapshot; not an exhaustive survey of all tissue MS studies
verified_normal_ms.query_match: any shared 8-mer, including longer source ligands

normal_ms_execution_reference.coverage: Supplied Atlas snapshot; not an exhaustive survey of all tissue MS studies

independent_primary_evidence_audit.broader_source_ligand_match: any shared 8-mer, all source ligand lengths
independent_primary_evidence_audit.effect_on_candidate_specific_intervals: none; additional matches already removed by non-CTA background

population_method: CIWD Table A2 known-allele proxy, HWE within locus and linkage equilibrium across loci; no panel normalization. Other-source frequencies are excluded.
cancer_method: Marginal p95 union bounds, no patient-overlap data or clinical coverage calculation.
tissue_method: Normal-MS policy: exclude. Exclusion uses primary donor-resolved Atlas nonmalignant heart/brain/lung HLA-I records, with 1 distinct donor(s). Tissue flags alone do not trigger this gate. Remaining observations are audited, not proof of safe regions.
